Use case: product-mockup. Create a completely NEW photorealistic studio product PHOTOGRAPH of a real glazed ceramic architectural ornament. The attached palace view is only a COLOR AND MATERIAL reference: match the warm golden-yellow ochre glazed roof tiles from that image, with subtle darker amber ceramic recesses. Do NOT reproduce any palace, roof, building, people, sky or scene from the reference. This is an isolated manufactured ceramic object, not a living creature. General Qing-inspired decorative form, not a replica of a specific protected artwork. Plain neutral medium-light GRAY seamless background, even diffuse studio illumination, gentle realistic ceramic highlights, only a faint contact shadow. NOT metallic gold, bronze, plastic, matte clay, cartoon or CGI. No text, characters, labels, logos, watermarks, corner marks, frame or multi-view layout. Whole object within frame with breathing room; sharp silhouette and readable sturdy relief details suitable for image-to-3D. One view only.
Subject: ONE standalone CHIWEN dragon-FISH roof-ridge END ornament, compact sculptural fish-like scaled body with a dragon-faced head. View from the SIDE with only about15degrees toward the front, near object height, so the full side silhouette dominates. Its large OPEN MOUTH faces HORIZONTALLY TO THE LEFT, as if gripping the end of an invisible horizontal roof ridge. Both upper and lower jaw form a clear horizontal open slot; no downward-facing or upward-facing mouth. There is NO actual roof ridge inside its mouth.
A single strong broad fish TAIL grows from the rear of the compact body and rises HIGH UPWARD, curving toward the head, with a readable split/fanned fish-fin tip. Tail is taller than the head. Fish scales, broad fins and shallow carved curls; restrained robust dragon brow and small horns close to head. NO long serpent neck, no horse-like or lion-like seated torso, NO four walking legs or paws. This must read as a dragon-fish ridge end, not a generic four-legged dragon statue.
The lower body rests on a SHORT SMALL INTEGRATED CERAMIC MOUNTING SADDLE aligned horizontally, just wide enough to fit onto a ridge. A little visible notch/seat at the bottom is fine. No large display plinth, no tower, no decorative pedestal, no rock, no roof, no tiles surrounding it. One coherent solid ornament with no floating pieces or duplicate tails. Intended real height around1.4meters, robust proportions. Square photograph,1536x1536 preferred, entire mouth, tail and compact base visible.

Subject: ONE straight roof-ridge PROCESSION consisting of EXACTLY SIX separate sculptural GROUPS, all facing LEFT along the same straight line. Leftmost FRONT group is ONE small robed RIDER seated astride ONE CHICKEN: clearly visible chicken beak, comb, folded wings and two feet; rider is visibly seated ON the bird. Treat rider+chicken as ONE sculptural group.
Behind this leading rider-on-chicken group, toward the right, are EXACTLY FIVE small SEATED ANIMAL GUARDIAN figurines. No sixth animal behind, no second rider or second chicken, no loose human. Make their robust little silhouettes somewhat different (rounded versus pointed ears, modest folded fins or short curled tails) but DO NOT identify them as a historically verified species sequence. Five seated animal bodies, each with its own distinct head facing left, tucked rear legs and short stout forelegs. All same warm yellow glaze. No wings spread far out or fragile thin free whiskers.
Composition: wide LANDSCAPE approximately2:1, at least1536pixels wide. Camera is nearly SIDE-ON with a gentle15degree three-quarter view and slightly above the small bases, so every group is fully visible and the six groups DO NOT overlap. Place all SIX in one single straight horizontal row, not a curve, not two rows, not side by side facing camera. Maintain clearly visible equal gaps between every neighboring group, roughly half a body width, with continuous neutral gray background seen in each gap. All groups are approximately25-35cm tall, consistent relative size, rider group only slightly taller. Show the whole row with ample blank margins at both ends.
Each group has a tiny low mounting foot. A VERY SLIM plain yellow ceramic connecting strip may join the feet along the straight line; keep it narrow, low and visually subordinate, not a massive ornate plinth, not a roof or platform. All six groups counted clearly from left to right: rider-on-chicken, animal1, animal2, animal3, animal4, animal5. Do not put these words or any numbers in the image.
